summary: Check Point Software Technologies furnished a Form 6-K (the US equivalent of a foreign private issuer's current report on Form 8-K) disclosing that its board appointed Yoram Tietz as a director on September 14, 2026. Tietz is a Senior Advisor at General Atlantic and former Managing Partner at EY Israel; he also sits on SolarEdge's board. Executive Chairman Gil Shwed endorsed the appointment as the company faces a major tech cycle. No shareholder vote, compensation terms, advisor, or departure of an incumbent director was disclosed. The filing is a routine board addition rather than a forced or abrupt C-suite event, so no deal terms or risk-arb angle apply; watch for committee assignments and any further board refresh.
